fw : us financials and new england gas 

regis 
i have had a discussion about the new england gas business with dan and john . we believe that the business is in decline due to high fix costs ( $ 1.0 - 1.9 / mmbtu ) and low variable costs ( ~$ 0. 10 / mm b t u ) . 

as you may know the natural gas business is not a pure play on the price of natural gas . net margins are almost always the same regardless of what the price of natural gas does . this is because the marginal cost of natural gas is very low . 

in order to make money you need to raise the price of natural gas above the marginal cost of producing it . the figure attached has a breakdown of the fix and variable costs . the fix costs are amortized over a fixed number of cubic feet . 

when you have a business that is declining in volume you get poorer and poorer margins because your amortized costs ( fix ) are spread over less units . if you eliminate all costs you can see that we make almost nothing on this business . 

the question is do we want to spend money to fix the costs and restructure the business ? in my opinion this business is not worth it . the marginal cost of natural gas is low and the fix costs are high . 

if anyone wants to take a closer look at the numbers i can do a more detailed breakdown for you . hopefully this gives you an idea of what is going on with the business .

enron ' s path to the top

by joann s . lublin
wall street journal
february 16 , 2001

enron corp . may be the best - known name in the new economy  but for much of the past decade  the big energy trader was a little - known company with a smaller revenue base .

enron expanded rapidly as a deregulated electricity market emerged in the late 1990 s  transforming the company from an electricity - trading boutique to a global conglomerate with a market capitalization of $ 61.5 billion at the close of regular trading thursday .

since 1995 alone  enron ' s revenues have increased 33 % annually .

" we are really the only place where electricity and natural gas are traded globally "  says michael l . miller  enron ' s chief financial officer . " if you want to trade in the new economy  you can ' t go anywhere else . "

enron ' s revenues grew from $ 3.8 billion in 1995 to $ 19.6 billion in 2000  according to the company . in the past 12 months  enron ' s revenues were $ 19.3 billion  a 33 % increase from the same period a year earlier  the company says .

enron ' s rapid growth has been accompanied by a series of strategic moves that have helped it expand its reach into new markets . the company became a leading merchant of electricity and natural gas  owning power plants and pipelines .

enron has also secured its position in the telecommunications and energy markets by buying stakes in power plants  pipelines and telecommunications firms around the world .

enron ' s growth has been driven by three factors : deregulation of the telecommunications and energy industries  use of technology to manage complex trading deals  and its trading expertise . the company ' s trading expertise comes from jeffrey r . skilling  the company ' s president  and andrew s . fastow  the firm ' s chief financial officer .

" enron has grown by taking advantage of deregulation and the internet "  says richard schwartz  a securities analyst at thomson financial services . " anyone can use the internet to do business  but enron ' s success has been in getting all the pieces to work together . "

when the telecommunications industry was deregulated in 1996  the company bought a 25 % stake in idt corp .  a long - distance company .

enron entered the broadband - cable field in 1999 with the purchase of providence starnet inc .  a broadband - cable company  for $ 5.75 billion . the purchase gave enron a foothold in the broadband - cable market with 1.8 million subscribers . enron plans to use the cable system to sell internet access and other services to homes and businesses .

in the natural - gas industry  the company entered the business of building pipelines in 1998 with the purchase of pmi energy services for $ 4.2 billion . the purchase gave enron a stake in the business of building pipelines .

" enron is a market - maker "  says richard j . seymour  a securities analyst at morgan stanley dean witter . " it operates in a number of different markets that are deregulating and is taking advantage of the deregulation . "

enron has also developed a reputation for being an innovator .

" one of the things that i really admire about enron is that they have been pioneers in the energy industry "  says richard carlson  chief executive of the gas utility division of american electric power . " they have been able to use technology well to improve their business . "

enron also has a strong capital markets presence  says david a . morgan  chief executive of bear stearns & co . " they ' ve made a real effort to develop their capital markets business . "

press release is attached below :

enron corporation and cpc international inc. today announced a strategic alliance to create a new energy company , enron global energy corp. (egc) , to develop , finance and operate energy projects throughout the world .

under the terms of the agreement , enron will transfer its energy assets to egc , which will be 60 percent owned by enron and 40 percent owned by cpc . enron will have a controlling 51 percent vote on the egc board of directors .

enron and cpc will contribute their respective asset portfolios to egc . these portfolios include an extensive lineup of power plants and oil and gas production and transportation assets around the globe . the new company anticipates generating approximately $1 billion in annual earnings and $100 million in annual cash flow , with the potential to nearly double these amounts once the assets are fully developed .

enron 's energy assets include 7 , 000 megawatts of power generation capacity , including four combined cycle gas turbines , which are among the most efficient and environmentally friendly power plants in the world .

enron 's energy assets also include a 500 , 000 barrel per day oil pipeline , a 1 , 200 mile natural gas transmission system and interests in oil and gas projects around the world .

cpc 's energy assets include a portfolio of power plants , including cogeneration facilities , as well as oil and gas production and transportation assets .

enron global energy corp. will be a leading independent energy company in the world and will possess one of the world 's largest energy portfolios . the senior management team will include enron 's current energy group management and senior management of cpc 's energy division . the new company will be headquartered in houston , texas , and will have operations in the u.s. , the caribbean , the netherlands , india , singapore , hong kong , china and australia .

- - - - - press release
enron corporation
enron corporation , the world ' s leading energy company , today announced 
that it has completed the acquisition of one of the largest independent power 
generators in north america . the acquisition is expected to add more than 
$ 200 million to enron ' s earnings per share in 2001 and more than $ 500 million 
to earnings per share by 2002 . the acquisition significantly increases 
enron ' s wholesale electric power portfolio , which now totals 52 , 000 megawatts 
of power capacity and 14 , 000 megawatts of power generation . enron also 
announced that it has reached agreement to sell one of its oldest and most 
successful businesses , enron oil & gas , for $ 1 . 2 billion to a group of 
private equity investors . the sale of enron oil & gas is expected to add more 
than $ 100 million to enron ' s earnings per share in 2001 and more than $ 200 
million to earnings per share in 2002 . both transactions are subject to 
regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions .
" our acquisition of this independent power generator , coupled with the 
divestiture of enron oil & gas , will enable us to focus on our core business 
of helping customers manage their energy costs and risks , " said jeff 
skilling , enron ' s president . " the transactions will have significant 
immediate and long - term earnings - enhancing benefits for enron shareholders .
we plan to use the proceeds from the enron oil & gas sale to reduce our 
debt . "
the acquisition of the independent power generator is the latest in a series 
of transactions between enron and lummus . it complements the recent 
acquisition by enron of the lummus / enron manufacturing corporation . the 
combined entity is now the world ' s largest independent power generator , 
with more than 52 , 000 megawatts of power capacity and 14 , 000 megawatts of 
power generation . the company ' s assets include more than 1 , 000 megawatts 
of power generation in the us and approximately 2 , 000 megawatts of generation 
in europe and asia . the increased generation capacity will greatly enhance 
enron ' s ability to meet the growing demand for power from its wholesale 
electricity customers in the us and around the world . the acquisition also 
significantly increases enron ' s power trading business and will enable the 
company to provide its customers with more and better priced power options .
the sale of enron oil & gas will enable enron to focus on its core business 
of helping customers manage their energy costs and risks . enron oil & gas 
provides oil , natural gas and liquefied natural gas to customers in north 
america and around the world . enron ' s oil & gas operations include the 
production of oil and natural gas from north american on - shore and offshore 
properties , and the supply of oil and natural gas to customers in north 
america and around the world . enron oil & gas also provides a full range of 
natural gas transportation and logistics services , including the construction 
of gas pipelines , compression and storage facilities , and the operation of 
pipelines . the sale of enron oil & gas is expected to be completed by the end 
of the first quarter of 2001 . the divestiture will result in a reduction in 
enron ' s work force of approximately 300 employees .
" the sale of enron oil & gas will reduce our exposure to commodity price 
risk and 
improve our overall financial position . " said jeff skilling , enron ' s 
president .
we are very pleased with these transactions and believe they will have a 
positive impact on enron ' s future performance .
